item.title: Alison dos Santos vence 400 metros com barreiras no Mundial de Atletismo Ultimate
item.description: O detentor do recorde mundial dos 400 metros com barreiras, o brasileiro Alison dos Santos, venceu a prova na última noite do primeiro Campeonato Mundial de Atletismo Ultimate, neste domingo em Budapeste.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O detentor do recorde mundial dos 400 metros com barreiras, o brasileiro Alison dos Santos, venceu a prova na última noite do primeiro Campeonato Mundial de Atletismo Ultimate, neste domingo em Budapeste. Após estabelecer o recorde mundial da prova há duas semanas, o brasileiro marcou 45,98 segundos e derrotou os rivais Rai Benjamin, dos EUA (46,40), e o ex-recordista Karsten Warholm, da Noruega (46,78). Jasmine Jones, dos EUA, venceu a prova feminina com o tempo de 52,45. A primeira edição do Mundial de Atletismo Ultimate contou com um prêmio total de US$10 milhões, o maior da história do esporte. Mais de 60 mil torcedores compareceram aos três dias de eventos com ingressos esgotados em Budapeste. (Reportagem de Lori Ewing)

item.title: El brasileño Alison dos Santos vuelve a brillar con triunfo en 400 metros con vallas en Budapest
item.description: El plusmarquista mundial Alison dos Santos se impuso en los 400 metros con vallas masculinos, mientras que Djamel Sedjati se alzó como ganador sorpresa de los 800 metros masculinos en la última noche del primer Campeonato Mundial de Atletismo Ultimate, celebrado el domingo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El plusmarquista mundial Alison dos Santos se impuso en los 400 metros con vallas masculinos, mientras que Djamel Sedjati se alzó como ganador sorpresa de los 800 metros masculinos en la última noche del primer Campeonato Mundial de Atletismo Ultimate, celebrado el domingo. El brasileño dos Santos, que batió el récord mundial hace dos semanas, registró un tiempo de 45,98 segundos para superar a sus rivales Rai Benjamin, de Estados Unidos, con 46,40, y al antiguo plusmarquista Karsten Warholm, de Noruega, con 46,78. Jasmine Jones, de Estados Unidos, se impuso en la prueba femenina con un tiempo de 52,45. El argelino Sedjati superó al canadiense Marco Arop, campeón del mundo de 2023, en los últimos pasos para ganar los 800 metros masculinos con un tiempo de 1:41,91. Arop cruzó la meta en 1:42,28, mientras que el campeón olímpico keniano Emmanuel Wanyonyi quedó tercero, con 1:42,44. Rumesh Pathirage, de Sri Lanka, lanzó a 91,09 metros y se impuso en la prueba masculina de lanzamiento de jabalina con una ventaja de casi cinco metros. La etíope Likina Amebaw se escapó del pelotón para ganar una carrera táctica de los 5.000 metros femeninos con un tiempo de 14:30,36. La primera edición del Ultimate Championship contó con una bolsa de premios de 10 millones de dólares, la mayor de la historia de este deporte. Más de 60.000 aficionados asistieron a las tres jornadas con entradas agotadas en Budapest.

item.title: Ravens WR Zay Flowers' 150-yard first half ends with hamstring injury
item.description: Baltimore Ravens wide receiver Zay Flowers set a career high with 150 receiving yards in the first half at Indianapolis on Sunday but went to the bench with a hamstring injury with six minutes left in the second quarter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Baltimore Ravens wide receiver Zay Flowers set a career high with 150 receiving yards in the first half at Indianapolis on Sunday but went to the bench with a hamstring injury with six minutes left in the second quarter. Baltimore announced Flowers was questionable to return to the game, after he torched the Colts for multiple huge plays. Flowers caught a 49-yard pass from Lamar Jackson on the Ravens' first offensive play of the game to set up a 5-yard Jackson TD run. Flowers left the Colts in the dust on a 54-yard touchdown in the second quarter. Flowers crossed the field from the left in front of Jackson 4 yards from the line of scrimmage, caught a sidearm throw, turned upfield and burst through a line of chasing defenders. It was his fourth catch for 138 yards with more than six minutes left in the second quarter. On his fifth grab, Flowers was quickly corralled by Colts cornerback Sauce Gardner and sat on the turf for a few seconds, rubbing the back of his left leg. Ravens cornerback T.J. Tampa left the game in the first quarter with a knee injury. --Field Level Media

item.title: Report: Maxx Crosby turned down Rams' trade interest
item.description: Maxx Crosby made it known to teams looking to trade for him after a move to the Baltimore Ravens fell through last March that he only wanted to play for the Las Vegas Raiders, NFL Network reported Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Maxx Crosby made it known to teams looking to trade for him after a move to the Baltimore Ravens fell through last March that he only wanted to play for the Las Vegas Raiders, NFL Network reported Sunday. Those interested teams, according to the network's sources, included the Los Angeles Rams, who eventually pivoted to a trade with the Cleveland Browns for five-time All-Pro Myles Garrett. The Philadelphia Eagles, Dallas Cowboys and San Francisco 49ers also checked in on Crosby, one of the NFL's top edge rushers. Crosby was expected to be a Raven last spring once Baltimore agreed to send Las Vegas a package led by two first-round draft picks, but the Ravens backed out over concerns about Crosby's knee. Once that decision became public, other clubs wanted to snag the five-time Pro Bowler for what was described to NFL Network as "pennies on the dollars." Crosby, for his part, posted on social media that "I'm a Raider. I'm back." The Raiders shut down Crosby for the final two games last season, citing a knee injury. Crosby's displeasure over that move made it appear as if a split would happen in the offseason. Indeed, the deal with the Ravens seemed to confirm a disconnect. But Crosby now appears to be happy in Las Vegas and is active for the Raiders' Week 1 game against the Miami Dolphins. He enters the 2026 season with 69.5 sacks in 110 career games, all with the Raiders, who drafted him in the fourth round of the 2019 NFL Draft out of Eastern Michigan. --Field Level Media

item.title: Cyclisme-L'Espagnol Mas remporte la Vuelta, son premier Grand Tour
item.description: L'Espagnol Enric Mas a remporté dimanche la Vuelta, signant sa première victoire dans un Grand Tour.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'Espagnol Enric Mas a remporté dimanche la Vuelta, signant sa première victoire dans un Grand Tour. Le coureur de l'équipe Movistar est le premier Espagnol à s'imposer dans cette course depuis Alberto Contador en 2014. Enric Mas s'était pratiquement assuré la victoire en creusant l'écart sur ses rivaux samedi lors de l'avant-dernière étape dans les montagnes de la Sierra Nevada. Trois fois deuxième de la Vuelta en 2018, 2021 et 2022, il monte enfin sur la plus haute marche du podium, devançant le Slovène Primoz Roglic (Red Bull-Bora-Hansgrohe) et son compatriote Felix Gall (Decathlon CMA-CGM). Enric Mas avait hérité du maillot rouge de leader à l'issue de la huitième étape après la lourde chute du grand favori de l'épreuve, Tadej Pogacar, qui visait un triplé inédit après ses victoires au Giro et au Tour de France.

item.title: Bloco de centro-esquerda tem vantagem apertada em eleições na Suécia, diz boca de urna
item.description: Os partidos de centro-esquerda da Suécia, que apoiam a líder social-democrata Magdalena Andersson para o cargo de primeira-ministra, mantiveram uma vantagem inicial de 51,3% nas eleições parlamentares deste domingo, segundo uma pesquisa de boca de urna realizada pela emissora SVT.
item.dc:creator: Terje Solsvik, Anna Ringstrom
item.content:encoded: Os partidos de centro-esquerda da Suécia, que apoiam a líder social-democrata Magdalena Andersson para o cargo de primeira-ministra, mantiveram uma vantagem inicial de 51,3% nas eleições parlamentares deste domingo, segundo uma pesquisa de boca de urna realizada pela emissora SVT. Os primeiros resultados da Autoridade Eleitoral da Suécia eram esperados nas próximas horas. Uma pesquisa separada realizada no dia da eleição pela emissora TV4 também mostrou a centro-esquerda na liderança. Embora muitas vezes sejam indicativas do resultado final, as pesquisas de boca de urna suecas nem sempre se mostraram precisas. Em 2022, por exemplo, uma pesquisa de boca de urna projetava que o bloco de Andersson sairia vitorioso, mas a eleição acabou sendo vencida por uma coalizão de direita liderada por Ulf Kristersson, que hoje é o primeiro-ministro da Suécia. Uma vitória do bloco de direita levaria os Democratas da Suécia, de extrema-direita — com 17,2% nas pesquisas da SVT —, ao governo pela primeira vez. A votação é vista por muitos como um referendo sobre o partido -- um grupo com raízes em uma ala neonazista -- que decidirá se o país nórdico de 10,6 milhões de habitantes continuará sua guinada à direita ou voltará ao progressismo pelo qual é conhecido há muito tempo. A oposição de centro-esquerda mantinha uma vantagem estreita sobre o bloco de direita no poder antes das eleições para o Parlamento, como mostraram várias pesquisas de opinião nesta semana. Mas Kristersson, que ficou atrás nas pesquisas de opinião ao longo de seus quatro anos no cargo, vem recuperando terreno nas últimas semanas de campanha, enquanto Andersson e seus social-democratas perdem força. Críticos afirmam que o governo de Kristersson está minando as liberdades civis ao forçar os imigrantes a se adequarem mais às normas culturais suecas ou a deixarem o país, por meio tanto de incentivos quanto de penalidades. O sucesso eleitoral dos Democratas da Suécia seria bem-vindo pelos partidos de extrema-direita em ascensão na Europa, que estão em alta após a vitória do partido anti-imigrante Alternativa para a Alemanha em uma eleição estadual alemã na semana passada. A extrema-direita espera obter ganhos nas próximas eleições em toda a Europa, sendo a candidatura do Reunião Nacional à Presidência da França no ano que vem o maior prêmio potencial até o momento. (Reportagem de Niklas Pollard, Simon Johnson, Johan Ahlander e Tom Little; Reportagem adicional de Ilze Filks, Ardee Napolitano, Janis Laizans para a Reuters TV; Greta Rosen Fondahn, Marie Mannes, Terje Solsvik e Anna Ringstrom)

item.title: No stopping Antonelli and Mercedes now, says Hamilton
item.description: Kimi Antonelli and Mercedes are sure to win this year's Formula One titles, Ferrari's seven-time champion Lewis Hamilton conceded on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: Kimi Antonelli and Mercedes are sure to win this year's Formula One titles, Ferrari's seven-time champion Lewis Hamilton conceded on Sunday. "There'll be no stopping him and Mercedes this year," Hamilton said after retirement from the Spanish Grand Prix left him still third overall but now 101 points behind the 20-year-old Italian who has won eight of 14 rounds so far and who replaced him at Mercedes after the 2024 season. "They've done a phenomenal job and they deserve it." Mercedes are 145 points clear of second-placed Ferrari, with reigning champions McLaren a further 52 behind. Antonelli's closest rival is his teammate George Russell, who is now 81 points adrift. Hamilton retired with a brake problem after starting in fourth place and rising to third on the opening lap. "I've got no brakes, guys," he told the team by radio before retiring on lap seven in last place. It was his first points blank of the season. Antonelli has now led 13 consecutive races and last weekend became the first Italian since 1966 to win his home grand prix at Monza. He is already the youngest driver to lead the championship, and the first Italian since 1953, and would be the youngest champion. "It’s great, but, you know, we’ve just got to keep pushing, keep delivering the results and, you know, just trying to do the best job I can whenever I go on track," said the youngster. "Of course, yes, I have a big lead, but you never know what can happen. So I just need to be ready for anything and keep maximising every opportunity I get, and then we’ll see where we end up at the end of the year." Four-time champion Max Verstappen, second on Sunday for Red Bull, and McLaren's reigning champion Lando Norris both shared Hamilton's view on who would be champion. "I’m definitely not having a comeback," said Verstappen, who almost snatched the title last year from way back, of his situation 147 points behind the Italian. Norris, 106 points behind Antonelli in fourth overall, agreed: "He’s leading by 80 points because he’s doing an incredible job," said the Briton. "I think it’s cool to see someone so young doing such an incredible job and more than likely go on and win the championship."

item.title: Cristiano Ronaldo pede suspensões vitalícias após gritos de “Jota” dirigidos a Ruben Neves
item.description: Cristiano Ronaldo disse neste domingo que os torcedores que pareciam entoar cantos fazendo referência ao ex-companheiro de seleção de Portugal Diogo Jota, dirigidos a Ruben Neves, durante uma partida da Liga Profissional da Arábia Saudita, deveriam ser banidos dos estádios de futebol para sempre.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Cristiano Ronaldo disse neste domingo que os torcedores que pareciam entoar cantos fazendo referência ao ex-companheiro de seleção de Portugal Diogo Jota, dirigidos a Ruben Neves, durante uma partida da Liga Profissional da Arábia Saudita, deveriam ser banidos dos estádios de futebol para sempre. Os gritos ocorreram no sábado, durante uma partida entre o Al-Taawoun e o Al-Hilal, time de Neves, em Buraidah, na Arábia Saudita. Jota morreu em 3 de julho de 2025, em um acidente de carro em Zamora, no noroeste da Espanha, juntamente com seu irmão, André Silva. Amigo íntimo de Jota, Neves foi um dos carregadores do caixão no funeral. Imagens filmadas das arquibancadas durante a partida e divulgadas nas redes sociais pareciam mostrar torcedores gritando “Jota”. Os gritos chamaram a atenção de Neves, que apontou para o olho e, em seguida, para o céu em resposta. Ao passar pela zona mista após a partida, Neves comentou: “Espero que eles não saiam para rezar depois disso”. Em resposta a uma publicação no Instagram que mostrava as imagens, Cristiano Ronaldo comentou em sua conta pessoal. “A liga precisa tomar medidas e punir esse tipo de comportamento dos torcedores”, disse. “Isso não é mais futebol, e tem de haver limites. Pessoas que se comportam assim nunca mais deveriam ter permissão para entrar em um estádio.” A partida terminou 6 x 0 para o Al-Hilal, com Neves jogando 75 minutos antes de ser substituído. A Reuters entrou em contato com o Al-Taawoun e o Al-Hilal para obter comentários. (Reportagem de Ruairidh Barlow)

item.title: VAR in focus as Haaland goal gives Man City controversial derby win
item.description: Erling Haaland's controversial goal proved to be the winner for Manchester City against Manchester United in their Premier League clash at Old Trafford on Sunday, but it is unlikely the big Norwegian will have the last word as debate rages whether the derby goal should have been allowed to stand.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Erling Haaland's controversial goal proved to be the winner for Manchester City against Manchester United in their Premier League clash at Old Trafford on Sunday, but it is unlikely the big Norwegian will have the last word as debate rages whether the derby goal should have been allowed to stand. Video reviews showed Haaland was onside when the ball was played, but an attempt by City midfielder Enzo Fernandez to head it into the net was seemingly ignored in the VAR deliberations, with the Argentinian appearing to be in an offside position when Josko Gvardiol played the initial ball in. The Premier League Match Centre said on social media platform X that Fernandez didn't play the ball, and therefore the goal was allowed to stand, but needless to say the red side of Manchester did not agree with that assessment. "I just don't get it, I really don't get it, I can't understand how we're trying to help referees, putting so many layers behind them, so many people, bodies and screens, and they can't make the right decision," United coach Michael Carrick fumed. "It's worrying if that's how the game's seen by those who are officiating it ... I can't be too critical of the players, and I won't be because I think we've done a lot of good things. Today we didn't quite find what we needed. The United boss, who has taken four points from his first four league games of the season, couldn't hide his disappointment. "I'm feeling for the fans today. We haven't got as many points as we would've liked at this stage, there's no getting away from that. We've just got to move on and get winning again." Defender Lisandro Martinez was equally frustrated. "I think it was offside. What I can't understand is the rules. He was there. I went to him because he was there in front of me, that's why Haaland was free at the back," he explained. "I want to be calm now, I want to control myself, it's so hard, because you lose, you lose a derby, you lose three points at home ... it's unacceptable. Because it's the best league in the world, you have the best teams in the world, the best players in the world, and now we have to go home with this injustice."

item.title: Dos Santos delivers again as Sedjati springs 800m surprise in Budapest
item.description: World-record holder Alison dos Santos won the men's 400m hurdles, while Djamel Sedjati was the surprise winner of the men's 800 on the final night of the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: World-record holder Alison dos Santos won the men's 400m hurdles, while Djamel Sedjati was the surprise winner of the men's 800 on the final night of the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship on Sunday. Fresh off his world-record run two weeks ago, Brazil's dos Santos clocked 45.98 seconds to beat rivals Rai Benjamin of the U.S. (46.40) and former record-holder Karsten Warholm of Norway (46.78). Jasmine Jones of the U.S. won the women's event in 52.45. Sedjati of Algeria surged past Canada's 2023 world champion Marco Arop over the final few steps to win the men's 800m in 1:41.91. Arop crossed in 1:42.28, while Kenya's Olympic champion Emmanuel Wanyonyi was third (1:42.44). Rumesh Pathirage of Sri Lanka threw 91.09m to win the men's javelin by almost five metres. Likina Amebaw of Ethiopia pulled away to win a tactical women's 5,000m in 14:30.36. The inaugural Ultimate Championship featured a prize pot of $10 million, the richest ever in the sport. Over 60,000 fans attended over the three sold-out days in Budapest.

item.title: Norris goes from Madring pole high to feeling 'insanely unlucky'
item.description: Lando Norris went from the high of celebrating one of the best pole positions of his Formula One career to feeling "insanely unlucky" as the champion rued a win that got away through no fault of his own on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: Lando Norris went from the high of celebrating one of the [USN:L6N45404Y TEXT:"best pole positions"] of his Formula One career to feeling "insanely unlucky" as the champion rued a win that got away through no fault of his own on Sunday. The McLaren driver looked set for his third victory of the season after starting at the front of the grid for the [USN:L6N45505G TEXT:"Spanish Grand Prix"] debut of Madrid's new track and carving out a lead of more than six seconds before a virtual safety car scuppered his chances. With overtaking as good as impossible, he had to settle for third behind Mercedes' winner Kimi Antonelli and Red Bull's Max Verstappen. "There was nothing I could do," Norris said of a situation where rivals behind him were able to pit and gain a precious time advantage but he was unable to do so because he had already gone past the pit lane entrance seconds earlier. When he pitted a lap later, the lead was gone for good. "Congrats to Kimi and Max. They drove a good race today, so just luck not on our side," said Norris. Third place left the Briton still fourth overall and 106 points behind leader Antonelli, whose win was his eighth of the campaign. Asked if he felt it was 'the one that got away', Norris qualified that. "It depends how you define 'got away'. It’s not like we did anything that made us lose it. We were just insanely unlucky today," he said. "I was the only one on the whole grid that didn’t get the chance to do the pit stop. That’s just unfortunate. "There’s been plenty of times where I’ve gained from it in the past and times where I’ve lost from it, and it’s racing, but never when fighting for a win. "It’s not the team’s fault, it’s not my fault. Simple as that. We were just unlucky," he added when asked if he or the team might have anticipated race control calling the virtual safety car once Aston Martin's Lance Stroll had stopped on track. Norris said staying out longer had not been an option either, with rivals on fresher tyres. "I had to come in at the end of the lap because it was the only chance. It was still effectively some pit loss, the fact that everyone’s kind of on colder tyres and you’re still minimising the pit loss," he said. "The medium tyre was destroyed and the hard tyre was amazing."

item.title: Golf Lowry delights home fans and cheering Trump with Irish Open win
item.description: Shane Lowry won the Irish Open for the second time on Sunday to the delight of the home crowd and a cheering U.S. President Donald Trump, who presented the Irishman with the trophy at the west of Ireland course owned by the Trump family.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Padraic Halpin
item.content:encoded: Shane Lowry won the Irish Open for the second time on Sunday to the delight of the home crowd and a cheering U.S. President Donald Trump, who presented the Irishman with the trophy at the west of Ireland course owned by the Trump family. Trump was among the spectators during a [USN:L6N454021 TEXT:"48-hour visit"] to Ireland. He arrived on Saturday after meeting Irish leaders in Dublin, forcing play to pause while his presidential helicopter landed between a fairway and a nearby field of cows. Lowry, who described Saturday's interruption as "an insane day", had taken control with an eight-under course record the day before and came one shot from matching it on Sunday, draining an 18th hold birdie to finish with a 23-under-par total. "He was unbelievable. He's a great guy," Trump said of Lowry, before further delighting the home fans by saying he was going to take tariffs off Irish whiskey. Lowry, who fought back tears as he paid tribute to his family at the end of his round, thanked Trump and Irish Prime Minister Micheal Martin for being at the event, saying it was amazing to have a U.S. president in attendance. The 2019 British Open champion's record 11-shot victory came 17 years after he became just the third amateur player to win a European Tour event at his home tournament. TRUMP WATCHES ON Trump, wearing a suit and white USA cap, greeted Lowry on the first tee and watched from a few feet away as he teed off. Trump told reporters that Lowry was "playing great." Lowry later said it was "a bit mad" to have the U.S. President watching on. While thousands of anti-Trump protesters marched through Dublin on Saturday, the president was cheered heartily throughout Sunday and during a brief appearance in the club bar in the adjoining hotel where he stayed on Saturday night. Trump watched the action on both days from an 18th-green balcony alongside his sons, Don Jr. and Eric and some of his grandchildren. He was joined by U.S. major champions Brooks Koepka and Patrick Reed, who finished in second place. Trump has always received a warm welcome in the tiny County Clare village of Doonbeg where the golf resort he bought in 2014 is a major employer for the local population of 300. Some fans wore the president's bright red "Make America Great Again" hats. "He will have detractors and people are not very happy politically-wise, but I just feel it's a golf event," said 69-year-old retiree Kathryn Murphy, welcoming Trump's attendance and support for the local economy. "I'm sure he has 1 million and one things to do, and it's a fantastic honour to have him here because America is a very good country to Ireland."

item.title: Ukraine's Zelenskiy imposes sanctions on former press secretary
item.description: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskiy imposed sanctions on a former press secretary on Sunday, accusing her and nine others of spreading Russian propaganda and of supporting Russia's aggressive policy toward Ukraine.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskiy imposed sanctions on a former press secretary on Sunday, accusing her and nine others of spreading Russian propaganda and of supporting Russia's aggressive policy toward Ukraine. Yuliia Mendel — who worked with Zelenskiy from 2019 to 2021, before Russia's invasion — responded with a message on Facebook saying it was unconstitutional to impose sanctions on Ukrainian citizens. She did not comment on the specific accusations. Mendel has given interviews criticising Zelenskiy's record since last year, when a number of members of the president's inner circle became embroiled in [USN:L1N41R08N TEXT:"corruption scandals"]. The suspects have denied the charges that have not been tested in court. The sanctions — announced by Zelenskiy in a decree — would last for 10 years and included asset freezes and restrictions on trade, the document read. They were an unusual measure to use against a former member of staff, though they have been used against political figures. In 2025, Ukraine imposed sanctions on former president and opposition politician Petro Poroshenko, including an asset freeze and a ban on withdrawing capital from the country, for what the domestic spy agency said were "national security" reasons. Sunday's order "imposes restrictions on 10 Russian and Ukrainian individuals who spread disinformation and Russian propaganda and support Russia’s aggressive policy toward Ukraine. Yuliia Mendel is among those sanctioned," the presidency said in a statement. Mendel, Zelenskiy's first press secretary after he became president, wrote on Facebook that she had been expecting the move. "Sanctions against Ukrainian citizens are unconstitutional, as are many of Zelenskiy's other decisions," she added. "Volodymyr Zelenskiy is imposing them on anyone who advocates for peace in Ukraine."

item.title: Trump reitera apoio à Irlanda unificada e diz que não falará sobre Escócia “por enquanto”
item.description: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, reiterou neste domingo seu apoio à separação da Irlanda do Norte do Reino Unido para se unificar com a República da Irlanda, mas afirmou que “ainda” não falaria sobre a independência da Escócia.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Padraic Halpin
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, reiterou neste domingo seu apoio à separação da Irlanda do Norte do Reino Unido para se unificar com a República da Irlanda, mas afirmou que “ainda” não falaria sobre a independência da Escócia. Trump surpreendeu autoridades em Dublin e irritou políticos pró-britânicos na Irlanda do Norte e em Londres ao apoiar entusiasticamente a unificação irlandesa durante uma visita a Dublin no sábado, dizendo que “adoraria” ver isso acontecer o mais rápido possível. “Vocês têm a Irlanda do Norte e têm a Irlanda, e me parece que uma das coisas mais ‘naturais’ de todos os tempos é uni-las”, disse Trump aos repórteres durante uma visita a um torneio de golfe em um de seus resorts, reforçando seus comentários iniciais. “Vocês perguntaram sobre a Escócia. Sobre isso, ainda não vou falar. Vou deixar para outro dia”, acrescentou. A Escócia, onde a família Trump também possui um resort de golfe, votou contra a independência do resto do Reino Unido em 2014. O primeiro-ministro do Reino Unido, Andy Burnham, descartou a realização de outra votação, bem como um referendo sobre a saída da Irlanda do Norte do Reino Unido. Trump fez seus comentários sobre a unidade irlandesa após uma reunião com Micheal Martin, o primeiro-ministro da Irlanda. Em suas primeiras declarações desde as falas de Trump, o premiê irlandês disse que a reação de alguns políticos unionistas foi “exagerada”. “Não deveria ser uma surpresa. Ele tem uma perspectiva diferente sobre as coisas”, disse Martin aos repórteres no domingo, após se encontrar novamente com Trump para almoçar no campo de golfe. Martin disse que os dois discutiram a Irlanda do Norte e sua relação com a República da Irlanda e que também explicou ao presidente como a região administrada pelos britânicos alcançou a paz. Um acordo de paz de 1998 pôs fim a três décadas de violência entre nacionalistas irlandeses que buscavam uma Irlanda unificada e unionistas que queriam que a Irlanda do Norte continuasse fazendo parte do Reino Unido. “Apoio a unificação, mas não vejo isso acontecendo agora. Fui muito claro quanto a isso”, disse Martin à BBC News em uma entrevista separada. “É provável que, se uma votação fosse realizada na próxima semana, seria muito difícil que fosse aprovada.” (Reportagem de Bo Erickson, em Doonbeg; Padraic Halpin e Conor Humphries, em Dublin, e Alistair Smout, em Londres)

item.title: Rússia ataca trem na fronteira entre Ucrânia e Polônia logo após passagem de "trem diplomático"
item.description: Um drone russo atingiu um trem de passageiros na fronteira da Ucrânia com a Polônia, membro da aliança militar ocidental Organização do Tratado do Atlântico Norte (Otan), neste domingo, logo após o ex-primeiro-ministro do Reino Unido Boris Johnson e outros diplomatas europeus terem utilizado a mesma linha.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Um drone russo atingiu um trem de passageiros na fronteira da Ucrânia com a Polônia, membro da aliança militar ocidental Organização do Tratado do Atlântico Norte (Otan), neste domingo, logo após o ex-primeiro-ministro do Reino Unido Boris Johnson e outros diplomatas europeus terem utilizado a mesma linha. O trem, que circulava por uma rota frequentemente utilizada por delegações estrangeiras que retornam de Kiev, foi atacado a apenas 2 quilômetros da fronteira com a Polônia, informou a operadora ferroviária ucraniana. Não houve relatos de vítimas. “Não era o nosso trem, mas aquele que passava poucos minutos depois de nós, perto da passagem de fronteira. Ele foi esvaziado quando o drone se aproximou e ninguém ficou ferido”, disse Carl Bildt, ex-primeiro-ministro da Suécia, no X. Ele e outros políticos estavam voltando para a Europa de trem após participarem de uma conferência em Kiev. “É perfeitamente possível que o alvo pretendido pelo drone russo fosse o trem diplomático, que partiu da estação antes do previsto após os horários dos trens terem sido ajustados em tempo real devido à constante ameaça de ataques russos”, informou a operadora ferroviária ucraniana, Ukrzaliznytsia, no Telegram. Boris Johnson, que também estava no trem que partiu da estação pouco antes do ataque, condenou o ataque como “aleatório e sem sentido” em uma publicação no Instagram. Com a linha de frente da guerra praticamente imóvel, tanto Moscou quanto Kiev intensificaram os ataques de longo alcance nas últimas semanas para tentar mudar o rumo da guerra. O ministro das Relações Exteriores da Polônia, Radoslaw Sikorski, descreveu os crescentes ataques da Rússia às portas da Otan como “uma escalada”. No início do domingo, um caminhão a menos de 1 km da fronteira da Ucrânia com a Polônia também foi atingido, levando o posto de fronteira de Dorohusk-Yahodyn a interromper brevemente suas operações, segundo guardas de fronteira. O Ministério da Defesa da Rússia afirmou ter atacado infraestruturas que facilitam o transporte de cargas militares da Europa no oeste da Ucrânia. A Rússia começou a atacar os postos de fronteira da Ucrânia com seus aliados ocidentais nas últimas semanas, como parte de uma campanha crescente de ambos os lados para minar a infraestrutura econômica do adversário, mais de quatro anos após o início da invasão russa. (Reportagem de Felix Light, Pavel Polityuk, Andriy Perun e Anna Wlodarczak-Semczuk)

item.title: Ahead of Fed meeting, Trump says US should have world's lowest interest rate
item.description: No country should have lower interest rates than the U.S., President Donald Trump said on Sunday, days before the Federal Reserve's next policy meeting.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Padraic Halpin, Conor Humphries
item.content:encoded: No country should have lower interest rates than the U.S., President Donald Trump said on Sunday, days before the Federal Reserve's next policy meeting. Speaking to reporters at the Irish Open golf tournament, Trump said he did not know whether Fed policy makers will raise interest rates at their meeting this week. But he argued that the U.S. "should be paying the lowest interest rate in the world" no matter what the Federal Reserve's data indicates about inflation and the economy. The Fed meeting will take place less than a week after a key measure of [USN:L1N452123 TEXT:"underlying inflation"], the Labor Department's Consumer Price Index, on Friday posted its largest increase in four months. That reinforced expectations that the U.S. central bank will raise rates. The central bank's governors are meeting just weeks before the midterm elections that will determine whether Republicans keep their slim majorities in both chambers of the U.S. Congress. A rate hike could add to voter concerns about affordability, according to recent [USN:L6N44M0S0 TEXT:"Reuters/Ipsos"] polls. Trump's approval ratings have fallen as inflation has persisted. He has argued that the Fed's interest rate levels have helped other countries at the expense of the U.S. “I know more about formulas than anybody, and with the best credit in the world, we make other countries rich," Trump said on Sunday. The president, a frequent critic of former Fed chair Jay Powell, has been more supportive of Fed leadership since his own pick for chair, Kevin Warsh, took charge earlier this year. But Trump recently has made his demands more clear. "LOWER THE RATE OR I'LL STOP TRADING WITH COUNTRIES WITH WHICH WE HAVE A DEFICIT," Trump posted on social media two weeks ago. Trump "will defend the independence of Kevin Warsh above all" no matter what the Fed does with interest rates, National Economic Council Director Kevin Hassett told "Fox News Sunday." But Hassett also underscored Trump's own preferences, saying "if it's a rate hike … I'm sure he's not going to be super happy about it."

item.title: Turquía detiene a decenas de personas tras serie de redadas dirigidas contra grupos LGBTQ+
item.description: Las autoridades turcas detuvieron al menos a 47 personas tras una serie de redadas en las oficinas de asociaciones LGBTQ+ en el marco de una investigación sobre prostitución y obscenidad, informó la fiscalía.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las autoridades turcas detuvieron al menos a 47 personas tras una serie de redadas en las oficinas de asociaciones LGBTQ+ en el marco de una investigación sobre prostitución y obscenidad, informó la fiscalía. Esta campaña de represión forma parte de una iniciativa que, según el Gobierno, tiene como objetivo proteger los valores familiares. La Fiscalía General de Estambul informó que durante el fin de semana se llevaron a cabo operaciones en 12 provincias contra 38 sospechosos, de los cuales 26 fueron detenidos, y las autoridades incautaron drogas, equipos digitales, alcohol de contrabando y un arma de fuego. En un comunicado aparte, la Fiscalía General de Ankara indicó que otras 21 personas habían sido detenidas en el marco de una investigación sobre la asociación LGBTQ+ Kaos GL y que aún se buscaba a cinco personas. Kaos GL dijo que al menos 50 activistas habían sido detenidos, entre ellos más de 10 que fueron detenidos en redadas policiales en sus domicilios. Además, señaló que las autoridades bloquearon el acceso a decenas de sitios web y cuentas en redes sociales vinculadas a organizaciones LGBTQ+ y activistas. Bajo el lema "Mi familia está a salvo", la campaña de represión del Gobierno se produce mientras el presidente Tayyip Erdogan promueve la "Década de la Familia y la Población", una iniciativa destinada a hacer frente a la caída de la natalidad y al envejecimiento de la población. Las organizaciones de derechos humanos han acusado al Gobierno turco de atacar cada vez más a la comunidad LGBTQ+ en los últimos años mediante un endurecimiento de la retórica y las restricciones. "El verdadero nombre de esta operación no es 'Mi familia está a salvo'; se trata de discriminación impulsada por el Estado, política del miedo y desmantelamiento de la sociedad civil", dijo la Asociación Turca de Derechos Humanos en X. Nacho Sánchez Amor, ponente del Parlamento Europeo para Turquía, calificó la amplia oleada de detenciones como "una escalada impactante" de la represión. "Esta imposición de una agenda moral constituye una violación flagrante de los derechos fundamentales y de los compromisos internacionales de Turquía, lo que lleva al país por un camino oscuro", dijo Amor en una publicación en X. La fiscalía dijo que existían pruebas de que se estaba ejerciendo una influencia inadecuada sobre niños y menores en cuestiones relacionadas con la orientación sexual y la identidad de género. El ministro de Justicia, Akin Gurlek, dijo que las investigaciones coordinadas por las fiscalías de Estambul, Ankara, Esmirna, Aydin y Mersin incluían procedimientos judiciales contra 162 sospechosos, nueve asociaciones y 13 empresas en 15 provincias.

item.title: Orioles put RHP Kyle Bradish on IL, likely ending his season
item.description: Baltimore right-hander Kyle Bradish could miss the rest of the season after the Orioles placed him on the 15-day injured list Sunday with lower abdominal discomfort.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Baltimore right-hander Kyle Bradish could miss the rest of the season after the Orioles placed him on the 15-day injured list Sunday with lower abdominal discomfort. The Orioles recalled right-hander Yaramil Hiraldo from Triple-A Norfolk to fill Bradish's roster spot. Bradish, 30, who signed a five-year, $90 million contract extension in July, is 7-14 with a 4.12 ERA in 29 starts this season. Of late, he has given up five earned runs or more in three of his last nine starts and has failed to pitch five innings five times in that span. Drafted by the Los Angeles Angels in the fourth round in 2018 and acquired by the Orioles in 2019, Bradish debuted in 2022 and is 26-29 in 96 starts with a 3.67 ERA over 512 2/3 innings. He underwent Tommy John surgery in June 2024 and made just six starts last season. Hiraldo, 30, is 1-0 with a 5.87 ERA in seven relief appearances this season after posting a 4.58 ERA in 18 relief outings last season, his first in the majors. --Field Level Media

item.title: Trump diz que “forças muito negativas” estão gerando preocupações exageradas sobre a IA
item.description: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, comparou neste domingo os críticos da inteligência artificial a “forças muito negativas” que levantam cenários que não vão acontecer, e afirmou que quer garantir que os EUA continuem sendo líderes do setor.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Padraic Halpin
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, comparou neste domingo os críticos da inteligência artificial a “forças muito negativas” que levantam cenários que não vão acontecer, e afirmou que quer garantir que os EUA continuem sendo líderes do setor. “Estamos à frente da China em IA. Somos o país mais sofisticado do mundo e, francamente, quero que continue assim, porque quem vencer na IA vence”, disse Trump a repórteres em seu campo de golfe na Irlanda, quando questionado se o setor de IA deveria desacelerar ou ser mais regulamentado. “Poderíamos estabelecer limites. Podemos fazer isso e aquilo. Mas acho que há muitas forças muito negativas levantando essa questão, que não deveriam estar fazendo isso, e estão trazendo à tona coisas que não vão acontecer.” Trump tem resistido a alimentar preocupações sobre a IA. O debate público sobre a IA se intensificou nos EUA depois que dois pesquisadores da Anthropic alertaram que o rápido avanço da tecnologia poderia levar à extinção da raça humana em um futuro não muito distante. Em seu segundo mandato, Trump tem apoiado amplamente as empresas de IA. Esses líderes do setor de IA e outras empresas de tecnologia também têm apoiado as iniciativas de Trump. Executivos do setor de IA injetaram dinheiro na campanha para as eleições legislativas de meio de mandato, que acontecerão em 3 de novembro e determinarão o controle do Congresso dos EUA. O grupo de financiamento eleitoral do presidente-executivo da SpaceX, Elon Musk, o America PAC, já gastou milhões apoiando candidatos republicanos e deve desempenhar um papel importante nos esforços para aumentar a participação eleitoral. O Pentágono alertou este ano sobre os riscos do modelo da Anthropic. Após os alertas dos pesquisadores, alguns presidentes-executivos do setor de IA estão pressionando para que o avanço dos modelos seja desacelerado. No sábado, o presidente-executivo da Anthropic, Dario Amodei, apresentou uma estrutura em três etapas destinada a moderar o ritmo do desenvolvimento e criar mais tempo para gerenciar os riscos. A proposta recebeu imediatamente o apoio de vários outros executivos de grandes empresas de IA, incluindo Musk e o presidente-executivo da OpenAI, Sam Altman. Em uma entrevista exibida no domingo no programa da CBS “Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan”, Amodei disse que a competição entre empresas de IA dos EUA e da China é o “dilema mais difícil” na tentativa de estabelecer um “limite de velocidade” para o ritmo de desenvolvimento da IA. “Não devemos nos iludir, porque os incentivos para sair na frente e a vantagem militar que se obtém com isso são tão grandes que a capacidade de verificar se o outro lado não está trapaceando precisa ser irrefutável”, disse ele. “Portanto, acho que isso vai levar anos, e, honestamente, não sei se é possível.” Jacob Coxon, um dos pesquisadores da Anthropic que se demitiu e depois emitiu os alertas, defendeu que os EUA trabalhem em conjunto com outros países para garantir um ritmo equilibrado. “Acho que precisamos de coordenação internacional; caso contrário, corremos o risco de entrar na mesma corrida que a China, o que poderia ser igualmente perigoso”, disse Coxon no programa Meet the Press, da NBC. (Reportagem de Bo Erickson; Reportagem adicional de Joseph Ax)

item.title: Kane winner hands Bayern laborious 2-1 win at promoted Elversberg
item.description: Visitors Bayern Munich needed a second-half winner from Harry Kane to battle past promoted Elversberg 2-1 on Sunday, and snap the hosts two-game winning start to the season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Visitors Bayern Munich needed a second-half winner from Harry Kane to battle past promoted Elversberg 2-1 on Sunday, and snap the hosts two-game winning start to the season. Kane threaded a shot past two defenders and the Elversberg keeper in the 72nd minute to hand the champions a nervous victory against the Bundesliga newcomers. Elversberg, buoyed by wins over Bayer Leverkusen and Borussia Moenchengladbach in their previous two league outings, showed no signs of being overawed by their illustrious opponents in their first ever Bundesliga encounter and had the visitors on the backfoot at the start. They also had the better scoring chances until Ismael Saibari found just enough space down the left to cut back into the box for Lennart Karl to finish the move with a tap-in at the far post in the 26th minute. But Vincent Kompany's team eased off almost instantly and the hosts bounced back, striking just past the hour mark when Maurice Krattenmacher curled a stunning effort into the top far corner to level. The Bavarians heeded the wake-up call, hit the woodwork with Michael Olise in the 70th before England captain Kane bagged the winner two minutes later. Bayern climbed up to fourth in the Bundesliga on seven points, two off leaders Freiburg and Borussia Dortmund, who have three wins from three matches. Elversberg are a point behind in sixth place.

item.title: India cruise past Afghanistan as Sharma blitz earns series lead
item.description: India claimed a dominant seven-wicket victory over Afghanistan in the first Twenty20 international in New Delhi on Sunday, taking a 1-0 lead in the three-match series after chasing down a victory target of 157 with 38 balls to spare.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India claimed a dominant seven-wicket victory over Afghanistan in the first Twenty20 international in New Delhi on Sunday, taking a 1-0 lead in the three-match series after chasing down a victory target of 157 with 38 balls to spare. After Sanju Samson fell in the third over, Abhishek Sharma launched a blistering counterattack, smashing 82 off 32 balls, while Ishan Kishan contributed 42 as the pair put India firmly in control of the chase. Sharma's aggressive strokeplay ensured Afghanistan never threatened the target, with India cruising towards victory before Mohammad Nabi struck twice late in the innings to remove both Sharma and Kishan. Captain Shreyas Iyer and Tilak Varma then guided their side over the line, with Iyer finishing unbeaten on eight from five deliveries. Afghanistan had earlier made a poor start after being put in to bat, with Jasprit Bumrah, returning to the side after a knee injury, striking in the opening over to dismiss Rahmanullah Gurbaz for a duck. They slipped to 41-4 inside the powerplay, with captain Ibrahim Zadran (11) and Sediqullah Atal (13) among the early casualties. A steady stream of wickets kept Afghanistan under pressure throughout the innings, but Azmatullah Omarzai provided some resistance with a counter-attacking 64 off 44 balls. The all-rounder shared a crucial 83-run partnership with Mohammad Nabi (33) to revive the innings before Nabi fell to Arshdeep Singh, who applied the brakes in the death overs and finished with figures of 3-19. India will face Afghanistan next on Tuesday.
